name: io.github.kouhxp/gutsy
title: gutsy
description: Local gut check before risky agent actions: calibrated safe/intended probabilities, no API calls.

environmentVariables.name: GUTSY_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the local gutsy-inference server

environmentVariables.name: GUTSY_INFERENCE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory with models.json; if set, gutsy-mcp starts gutsy-inference itself

environmentVariables.name: GUTSY_PROCEED_MIN
environmentVariables.description: Minimum P(proceed) and P(intended) to recommend proceeding
